title: Additive iteration of exact-couple diagrams
statement: Let K be preadditive and B abelian. Suppose X assigns a type-zero exact couple to each object of K and m assigns a couple morphism to each arrow, preserving identities, composition and addition on both D and E. Then there are additive D and E functors on every derived page, with object isomorphisms to the iterated couples, couple morphisms realizing their maps, the given initial maps, and the defining successor image and homology squares. Here an exact couple means [def-sp-exact-couple], and B is abelian in the sense of [def-sp-abelian].

source.place: Tags 011R and 011T: exact-couple derivation and functorial homology, with additive restriction and quotient uniqueness.

proof.text: Derive each couple morphism by restriction to alpha images and differential kernels and descent to the homology cokernel. Cancel image and kernel inclusions to prove preservation of identity, composite and sum on their restrictions, then cancel the homology projection to prove the corresponding E equations. Induct on the number of derivations and form the functors with these maps. Uses [lem-sp-derived-couple-functoriality], [def-sp-exact-couple].
